questions.title: Nested roots that are secretly absolute values
questions.prompt: Find all real $x$ satisfying $\sqrt{x+3-4\sqrt{x-1}}+\sqrt{x+8-6\sqrt{x-1}}=1$.
hints: Each radicand is a perfect square in u.

ladder.method: Each radicand is a perfect square in u.

steps.d: Sum of distances from $u$ to $2$ and $3$ equals $1$ iff $2\le u\le3$

traps.why: That is the range of u, not x.
